title: CENE: Context-Enforcement Network Engine
description: CENE enforces an AI agent's scope outside the model: data-quality tiers set the agent's authority, a short-lived signed Context Token lists the tools, arguments and rows a task may use, a gateway checks every tool call (refusing, or holding for two approvers) and a hash-chained audit log records every decision. This release includes the AgentDojo evaluation code (frozen policy agentdojo-policy-v1) used with Gemma 4 12B-it and Qwen3-8B.
